doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

chapter: Studio work in the rock and roll era
title: Telling Ruth about the day: Sinatra and missing John's birth
summary: Ruth says she did not ask about his day; Bucky was at a Panama Francis date with wrong music the day John was born.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: So Ruth, when Bucky came home, either that night after a day in the studios, or the next morning, did you do a like, “well how was your day? What happened yesterday?” Would you do that kind of thing?

No I didn’t do that kind of thing. I had kids running, and I had to go do food shopping, I had to find out what he was going to do, was he coming home tonight, tomorrow and on and on. That’s what I did. I had to take them to school.
Do you remember what kind of event in his day might have come up as something that was really interesting. What might he have talked about that was worth —
Significant.
Significant. That was worth hearing about.
Sinatra I guess.
Yeah. I made that record date with Frank Sinatra.
It took that much, to get to Sinatra.

No but when John was born I was doing an album with Panama Francis. And that day that John was born we had the wrong music for the band that was there. We were supposed to have strings and we had a brass band there. And naturally we had to shift gears you know, and get all the music for the band that was supposed to be on the record, as opposed to what was there. So that’s why I missed the whole birth.
See what he was getting to?
You weren’t there when John was born?
No. I could have been.
He comes into the room — you could turn it off if you want.
That’s all right.

But he comes into the room and, “did you have the baby” or something like that. “Yeah. We had a boy.” So that was the beginning. And then we had Martin after that so we had two girls first and then the two boys. But I think I even spoke to Milt about it or one of them — or Panama Francis. Yeah. I said, “you know I had the baby.”
And Bucky was with you, right?
Right.
You know nowadays we’re so used to being able to connect immediately — get your cell phone and you could at least say, “I’m not going to get there.” Right? But that wasn’t the case back then.
I was there already with the wrong music, so that made a big delay.
I see.
We corrected it.
